title: Semantius language file
description: One language, in the single shape every place a language lives speaks: the files shipped under apps/web/public/locales, an operator's replacement of one, a stage host's copy, a work file's source. The map is FLAT. A code string is keyed by its own English source text (there are no message ids; a disambiguated one is prefixed, `columnVisibility.View`); model text is keyed by its model path under the reserved `module.` root (`module.nwind.orders.field.city.title`, an enum value by its STORED value); a server error by its SQLSTATE plus constraint name, or by its own template. en-US.json is the index: the same shape with the SOURCE text as the value of every key.

locale.description: The catalog language as a BCP-47 tag, e.g. de-DE. This is the language of the TEXT, never the formatting locale — those are two separate preferences.

name.description: The language's own name for itself ('Deutsch'). Wins over Intl.DisplayNames in the account menu, which is how a tag the browser has no display name for still reads as a language.

messages.description: Key to translation. An empty value means 'not translated yet' and falls through to the source text — which is what discovery writes when the running app meets a key this language does not know.

obsolete.description: Translations whose code string was reworded or removed, kept so they are not lost silently. Written by the optional `i18n:extract` scan, emptied by `i18n:extract --prune`. Never a `module.*` key: nothing retires those.
